_comment: Every custom value the client website template uses. 'existing' values are already in the review-automation snapshot; 'new' values were created in the Meridian AI Solutions sub-account on 24 Oct 2026 with these examples. GHL derives the key from the name (lowercase, spaces to underscores), so names must not change once pages reference them. 'example' is only used for the local preview build and as the starting value in the template sub-account. Avoid double quotes and < > in values: GHL inserts them as-is, and the JSON-LD block would break on a stray quote.
